others.route: Work permit (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration)

note: Cook Islands: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration's permit definitions (its COVID-19 policy on permits of 2 April 2020) give the work permit to a non-Cook Islander or non-permanent resident living in the Cook Islands for employment or business, and a visitor permit (up to 90 days for a New Zealand passport, 31 for others) for rest and relaxation, with no work on an entry permit; New Zealand citizens who aren't Cook Islanders are no exception. Cook Islanders and permanent residents are home. The current criteria pages (mfai.gov.ck) refuse this client, the 2020 policy is the latest text read, and no performers' route, exemption or days are named.

sources.title: Government of the Cook Islands, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration, COVID 19 – Policy on Permits (2 April 2020)
